title: Bound every GitHub call in krn deliver transport with a per-call timeout
body:
Outcome: no GitHub call through src/deliver/transport.ts blocks longer than a bounded per-call timeout; a timed-out call is retried as transient.
Why: run() uses spawnSync with a 1 h timeout, and host IPv4 to api.github.com stalls on ~1 in 3 connections; `krn ci wait` (every slice) and `krn ci logs` can hang up to an hour. #488 fixed the same stall only inside ledger.ts with a private 5 s timeout and 3 tries (.krn/runs/roadmap-refill-3/gh-timeouts.md). A lead `git fetch` hung over 2 minutes on 2026-11-09 the same way.
Proof: a test with a stub gh that sleeps shows github() returning or retrying within the bound; ledger reuses the shared helper or names why not.
Scope: src/deliver/transport.ts, src/deliver/ledger.ts and their tests.
